product_one_liner.value: Envoy unifies visitor management, workplace spaces, and communications in a workplace management platform for facilities, security, and IT teams.
product_one_liner.notes: The product page describes one platform unifying visitors, spaces, and communications and explicitly identifies facilities, security, and IT teams as its users: https://envoy.com/products.

pricing_page.notes: A public pricing page lists plans, including an Enterprise plan with custom pricing: https://envoy.com/pricing.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: The customer stories page identifies G+D as using Envoy (https://www.envoy.com/case-studies), and the Headspace case study includes a customer's statement about needing Envoy for its office (https://envoy.com/case-studies/headspace). | named_customers.0: G+D is identified as using Envoy to welcome visitors at https://www.envoy.com/case-studies. | named_customers.1: The Headspace customer case study contains a first-person statement about using Envoy: https://envoy.com/case-studies/headspace.

employee_band.notes: The company profile explicitly reports the employee band as 201–500: https://indexed.vc/companies/envoy. This is a third-party headcount classification.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: Envoy explicitly labels San Francisco as its headquarters on its about page: https://envoy.com/about-us. | hq_country: The about page identifies San Francisco as headquarters and provides its California postal address, placing headquarters in the United States: https://envoy.com/about-us.

founded_year.notes: Envoy's company profile explicitly lists 2013 as its founding year: https://linkedin.com/company/envoy-inc.

eng_blog.notes: The engineering index contains at least two named, first-person product-building posts: Shraddha Chadha on the Kafka/LLM/geospatial threat-detection pipeline and Matthew Ellwood on rendering React within Ember. The site presents its contributors as Envoy's builders, although the index does not supply their formal job titles: https://engineering.envoy.com/.

public_docs.notes: Envoy has a public developer portal linking to guides and API documentation (https://developers.envoy.com/), plus a public help center containing multiple product and compliance articles, evidenced by its related-article links (https://envoy.help/en/articles/3450292-envoy-compliance-certifications).

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The official board lists the relevant engineering and data titles without any qualifying AI/ML/data-science title (https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/envoy?format=json). A complete 23-role listing likewise contains none (https://www.jobscroller.net/companies/envoy). Member of Technical Staff, Envoy Response involves AI in its description but does not satisfy the required title test; Senior Data Analyst also does not qualify. Confidence is limited by dynamic hiring data and differing listing counts.

model_provider.value: Anthropic Claude, accessed through Amazon Bedrock
model_provider.notes: Envoy's AI usage documentation explicitly states that Anthropic's Claude model processes information through Amazon Bedrock: https://envoy.help/en/articles/16301838-ai-usage-in-envoy-products.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: Envoy's Trust Center lists SOC 2 Type 2, ISO/IEC 27001, and HIPAA compliance (https://trust.envoy.com/); its legal page explicitly states that Envoy services comply with GDPR (https://envoy.com/legal/compliance). These are public compliance claims, not an assertion that every listed framework issues a certification. PCI DSS is excluded because the legal page describes helping customers meet physical-access requirements rather than claiming Envoy's own PCI DSS certification. | compliance_certs.0: SOC 2 Type 2 is explicitly listed at https://trust.envoy.com/. | compliance_certs.1: ISO/IEC 27001 is explicitly listed at https://trust.envoy.com/. | compliance_certs.2: HIPAA appears as a compliance claim at https://trust.envoy.com/. This does not imply that every customer deployment is automatically HIPAA compliant. | compliance_certs.3: Envoy explicitly states its services comply with GDPR at https://envoy.com/legal/compliance.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The company announcement calls the round Series C (https://envoy.com/workplace-management/envoy-series-c-cant-stop-wont-stop), and the funding profile identifies it as the latest round (https://indexed.vc/companies/envoy). | funding_date: The Series C announcement is dated January 11, 2022, giving 2022-01 (https://envoy.com/workplace-management/envoy-series-c-cant-stop-wont-stop). The funding profile identifies January 2022 as the latest round (https://indexed.vc/companies/envoy). | funding_amount_usd: Envoy announced $111 million in Series C capital (https://envoy.com/workplace-management/envoy-series-c-cant-stop-wont-stop). The funding profile identifies that round as its most recent, distinguishing the round amount from $170.2 million in total funding (https://indexed.vc/companies/envoy).

raised_18mo.notes: The latest identified round is the January 2022 Series C, preceding the eighteen-month window beginning May 9, 2025. Sources: https://envoy.com/workplace-management/envoy-series-c-cant-stop-wont-stop and https://indexed.vc/companies/envoy.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The Mid Market Account Executive posting provides a live application link (https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/Envoy/d8a76039-7a58-4e28-988c-b013be7a3aa8). The current-role listing also includes EMEA Outbound BDR, corroborating qualifying sales hiring (https://hiringcensus.com/c/ashby/envoy).

launched_6mo.notes: Envoy's AI information page dates the Envoy Response launch to August 6, 2026. It combines AI-analyzed threat intelligence and incident management, constituting a product launch within the six-month window: https://envoy.com/ai-information.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Envoy announced Mauricio Ramirez's appointment as Chief Revenue Officer. The newsroom dates the announcement February 26, 2026, while its feed carries a July 2026 publication timestamp; both fall within the requested twelve-month window. Sources: https://envoy.com/press and https://envoy.com/press-release/rss.xml.
